description: Conventional commit messages (type(scope): subject), used by changelog and release tools

max_length.description: Maximum length of the first line

hooks.name: conventional commit
cmds: head -n1 "$1" | grep -qE '^(({{types}})(\(.+\))?!?: .+|Merge .+|Revert .+|fixup! .+|squash! .+)' || { echo 'The commit message must look like "type(scope): subject", with type in {{types}}'; exit 1; }
[ "$(head -n1 "$1" | wc -c)" -le $(({{max_length}} + 1)) ] || { echo 'The first line of the commit message is longer than {{max_length}} characters'; exit 1; }
